name: Ihudir

abilities.name: Sword Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Ihudir cleaves you with his sword, dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Ihudir charges forward abruptly, tackling anyone in his way, dealing high physical damage and knocking down. This attack has no AoE indicator.

abilities.name: Joint Slam
abilities.description: Ihudir and Eliam both combine forces as they jump at you back to back, causing a shockwave on impact, indicated by a large circular AoE, dealing high physical damage and staggering each.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.description: When Eliam Merick reaches 35%, if Ihudir was slain before, he is resurrected back to full health by Eliam, along with Liramindrel.

related_quests: A Rose of Many Thorns: A knightly order has been hoarding dangerous relics, and Lyranth wishes to claim one.
Pledge: Red Petal Bastion: Enter Red Petal Bastion and return Undaunted.
summary: Ihudir is a Redguard found in Red Petal Bastion. He is equipped with the Duplici Gladio and accompanied by Liramindrel and Eliam Merick, who together make up the second boss of the dungeon.
